LABEL: sweetness suppresses bitterness
condition: Sucrose added to quinine and rated by children and adults, using forced-choice paired comparison and the general Labeled Magnitude Scale; bitterness fell from moderate to weak, and adults carrying the sensitive form of TAS1R3 reported the larger reduction.
A IAO:0000115: Interaction in which the presence of sweetness lowers the perceived intensity of bitterness.

LABEL: sweetness suppresses alkaloid bitterness
condition: Sucrose added to caffeine and rated by children and adults, using forced-choice paired comparison and the general Labeled Magnitude Scale; adults carrying the sensitive form of TAS1R3 reported the greater reduction for caffeine.
A IAO:0000115: Interaction in which the presence of sweetness lowers the perceived intensity of alkaloid bitterness.

LABEL: sweetness suppresses thiourea bitterness
condition: Sucrose added to 6-n-propylthiouracil and rated by children and adults, using forced-choice paired comparison; suppression held for every bitter agent tested, but the further moderation of it by TAS2R38 sensitivity did not reach statistical significance for PROP.
A IAO:0000115: Interaction in which the presence of sweetness lowers the perceived intensity of thiourea bitterness.

LABEL: saltiness suppresses bitterness
condition: Sodium chloride mixed with quinine hydrochloride and rated by functional measurement with a two-stimulus procedure; the suppression is asymmetric, quinine having almost no suppressive effect on the saltiness of sodium chloride in return.
A IAO:0000115: Interaction in which the presence of saltiness lowers the perceived intensity of bitterness.

LABEL: sweetness suppresses sourness
condition: Sweeteners matched for perceived sweetness, sucrose among them, mixed with each of four citric acid concentrations and rated by functional measurement with a two-stimulus procedure; equisweet sweeteners suppressed sourness equally across the concentration range, so the suppression tracks perceived sweetness rather than sweetener concentration.
A IAO:0000115: Interaction in which the presence of sweetness lowers the perceived intensity of sourness.

LABEL: sourness suppresses sweetness
condition: Citric acid mixed with sucrose in aqueous solution and rated by consumers in China and in Denmark; the suppression of sucrose sweetness did not differ between the two cultures, and consumer clusters differed in how strongly they showed it.
A IAO:0000115: Interaction in which the presence of sourness lowers the perceived intensity of sweetness.

LABEL: bitterness suppresses sweetness
condition: Factorial combinations of four sucrose and four quinine hydrochloride concentrations; the suppression of sweetness appeared at the highest quinine concentration in PROP super-tasters and medium-tasters, and was absent in non-tasters.
A IAO:0000115: Interaction in which the presence of bitterness lowers the perceived intensity of sweetness.

LABEL: thiourea bitterness suppresses sweetness
condition: Mixtures of phenylthiocarbamide and sucrose; suppression of sweetness was stronger in PTC tasters than in non-tasters and tracked perceived bitterness rather than PTC concentration, which the authors read as evidence for neural inhibition rather than a chemical or receptor-level interaction.
A IAO:0000115: Interaction in which the presence of thiourea bitterness lowers the perceived intensity of sweetness.

LABEL: sourness enhances saltiness
condition: 3 mM citric acid added to 75 mM and to 100 mM sodium chloride in a sensory evaluation; salty taste intensity rose for the 100 mM solution, and the authors conclude the addition may enhance saltiness rather than reporting the rise at both concentrations.
A IAO:0000115: Interaction in which the presence of sourness raises the perceived intensity of saltiness.
